title: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warns AI could make it harder for fresh Indian engineering graduates to find jobs, urging an immediate CS curriculum overhaul (Sayan Chakraborty/Nikkei Asia)
summary: Sayan Chakraborty / Nikkei Asia: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warns AI could make it harder for fresh Indian engineering graduates to find jobs, urging an immediate CS curriculum overhaul — BENGALURU — Recent college graduates in India could struggle to land technology jobs as companies automate entry-level coding …
